why: Owner on r8: mouth and sync good; eyes, head, shoulders and hands dead and stiff. Seedance needs stillness wording to keep the face, which freezes everything else. These models drive the whole performance from the audio.

args.prompt: The man speaks directly to the camera, seated at the wooden table, relaxed and engaged like a real conversation. Natural eye contact with the lens, lively eyes with ordinary blinks and small brow lifts on stressed words. Natural head movement with emphasis, breathing visible in the chest and shoulders, small shoulder shifts, and one or two small natural hand gestures that lift off the table and settle again. Fixed camera, same wide framing. No exaggerated expressions, no finger pointing.
